name: Grok 4.6

weak.d: Terminal-Bench 3.0 (26.0) and SWE-Marathon (31.9) — the card's two weakest reported figures, both endurance-style tasks.

res.d: CursorBench 3.2 (70.8) — strongest reported figure on this card.

lims: No dedicated limitations section — card is capability/benchmark-forward; safety folded into refusal-rate figures rather than a named block.
Coding and knowledge-work focus, for now — deployment channels emphasize agentic coding (Cursor, Grok Build) and enterprise knowledge work (Office add-ins) rather than consumer chat surfaces.
blurb: One of the first Grok system cards published in full — 42 pages and 27 evaluations, a marked step up in disclosure for a lab whose prior card reported no capability benchmarks at all. Reaches results with fewer steps and fewer output tokens than other frontier models.
